semantic_truth.rule: proxy work is written as proxy work

gate7.reason: Production planning is ready, production blockers are clear, required planning rows are complete, and DRAFT proxy capture is machine-verified (no human approval is used or required).

gate8.note: PASS on machine evidence with realCaptureEvidence false — proxy satisfied the DRAFT disposition without ever registering as real capture

lifecycle_gate_reader_fix.file: scripts/package-runs-index.js (readLifecycleGate only, not index discovery internals)
lifecycle_gate_reader_fix.defect: sourceCaptureEvidenceInvalid treated ANY non-real capture evidence as invalid, overriding the evaluator PASS. True in PRODUCTION, false in a zero-human DRAFT where verified proxy capture IS the evidence.
lifecycle_gate_reader_fix.fix: a valid DRAFT proxy disposition counts; proxyCapture is null in every other mode so nothing else changes
lifecycle_gate_reader_fix.second_fix: capture-checklist.md now carries the canonical "Capture checklist status" and "Ready for rough cut" lines the reader parses — without them the run status label never left "Needs capture" no matter how complete the evidence

mode_behaviour.REVIEW: holds at gate 9 — reuse, no recapture, materializer refuses to run
mode_behaviour.PRODUCTION: capture reopens to gate 8; realCaptureEvidence false, proxy readiness not applicable, proxy evidence retained as history

negatives.script_revision: narration stale -> materialization invalid -> gate 7 NEEDS CAPTURE, gate 8 not PASS, completion not inherited
negatives.media_mutation: proxy not ready -> materialization refused -> gate 7 reopens

negatives.human_note: preserved across regeneration; cannot assert real capture because machine rows are restored
negatives.idempotency: second pass reports every artifact unchanged with identical machine hashes

gate9.blocker: there is nothing assembled to watch. No automatic rough-cut/edit assembler exists: edit-plan.js is a typed schema module (SCHEMA_VERSION, TRACK_ROLES, FIELDS, canonicalize), not a renderer, and nothing muxes the proxy presenter video with the narration audio into a single watchable draft.
gate9.not_faked: no watch notes, no ratings, no rough-cut approval were written
